summary: The Wellness Lab has strong services and 303 reviews, but the page has dead links, mismatched contact details and little visible proof.

findings.problem: Four of five Signature Treatments cards, including Laser Hair Removal, link to #. The Eid offer button goes to the Ramadan offers page.
findings.cost: A visitor ready to book a signature treatment hits a dead end.
findings.fix: Working treatment pages with a book now button.

findings.problem: The email shows .qa but its link goes to .com.qa. One phone link starts tel:++974. 'WhatsApp us' has no number.
findings.cost: Mistyped contact links lose enquiries from phones.
findings.fix: One checked set of contacts and a real WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: Header says 303 reviews but about six show. No before and after. Staff names and roles in reviews conflict, and one review says a doctor has left.
findings.cost: Thin proof and stale staff mentions weaken trust.
findings.fix: Review wall, results gallery and a current team page.

findings.problem: Typos 'Nutritions & Wellness' and 'big Discount'. Menus repeat. The booking form has no phone field.
findings.cost: Without a phone number you cannot call back an enquiry.
findings.fix: Clean copy and a form with a phone field.

redesign: A clean booking flow with phone, WhatsApp and a clear offers page.
A proper review wall, results gallery and current team page.
